summary: As of mid-2026, the LLM landscape is dominated by ChatGPT/GPT-5 in consumer web traffic (53.9% share) while enterprise API usage has shifted toward Anthropic's Claude (40% of enterprise API spend). The gap between open-source and closed frontier models has effectively closed on key benchmarks like SWE-Bench, with DeepSeek, Llama, and Qwen now competing directly with GPT and Claude at a fraction of the cost. Multi-cloud aggregator presence through AWS Bedrock, Azure OpenAI Service, Google Vertex AI, Snowflake Cortex, and IBM watsonx remains a decisive adoption multiplier for enterprise deployments.

models.name: GPT-5 / GPT-5.1
models.popularity_notes: Holds 53.9% of worldwide AI chatbot web-visit share in May 2026 and leads all LLM API providers per Future AGI; available on Azure OpenAI Service, AWS Bedrock, and Google Vertex AI, giving it unmatched enterprise aggregator reach.
strengths: Largest installed developer base globally
Best-in-class multi-step reasoning and conversational dialogue
Widest aggregator distribution (Azure, AWS Bedrock, Vertex AI)
Broad ecosystem of plugins and integrations
Strong real-time interaction capabilities
models.best_for: General-purpose enterprise applications, conversational AI, and complex reasoning tasks requiring broad cloud platform support

models.name: Claude Opus 5 / Claude Fable 5.1
models.popularity_notes: Commands 40% of enterprise API spend per Menlo Ventures 2025 data and reached 952.6 million monthly web visits in May 2026 (up 855% YoY); available on AWS Bedrock and Google Vertex AI, making it the top enterprise API choice by revenue share.
strengths: Leads enterprise API adoption at 40% spend share
Top score on Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index (66) per September 2026 data
Best-in-class safety and alignment for enterprise compliance
Exceptional long-document analysis and coding
Available on AWS Bedrock and Google Vertex AI
models.best_for: Enterprise API workloads requiring safety, compliance, and top-tier reasoning performance

models.name: Gemini 2.5 Pro
models.popularity_notes: Grew to 27.9% of worldwide AI chatbot web-visit share in May 2026 (up from 5.4% a year prior, ~450% growth) with 2.9 billion monthly visits; natively embedded in Google Vertex AI and deeply integrated across Google Workspace, giving it massive enterprise reach.
strengths: Fastest-growing major LLM by web traffic share (+450% YoY)
Industry-leading 1M token context window
Native integration with Google Workspace and Vertex AI
Strong multimodal capabilities across text, image, audio, and video
Deep integration with Google Search for real-time grounding
models.best_for: Long-context document processing, multimodal enterprise workflows, and teams already operating within the Google Cloud ecosystem

models.name: DeepSeek-V4 / DeepSeek-V4-Pro
models.popularity_notes: Holds 4.1% of worldwide chatbot web-visit share and is the top open-source LLM per multiple 2026 rankings; its 1.6-trillion-parameter MoE architecture and 1M-token context window brought it to near-parity with closed frontier models at dramatically lower cost.
strengths: Top open-source LLM trading blows with closed models on benchmarks
Extremely cost-efficient MoE architecture (1.6T parameters)
Strong coding performance matching Claude Opus 4.x on SWE-Bench (~80%)
1M token context window
Developed at fraction of typical LLM compute cost
models.best_for: Cost-sensitive enterprise deployments, coding automation, and teams requiring a self-hostable frontier-grade open model

models.name: Llama 4
models.popularity_notes: Listed in top five open-weight alternatives across multiple 2026 ranking sources with massive HuggingFace download volume driven by Meta's open-release strategy; available on AWS Bedrock, Azure, and Google Vertex AI, giving it the broadest aggregator coverage of any open-source model.
strengths: Highest download volume of any open-weight model family on HuggingFace
Available across all major cloud aggregators (AWS Bedrock, Azure, Vertex AI)
Strong general reasoning benchmark scores
Broad community ecosystem and fine-tuning support
Zero licensing cost for self-hosted deployments
models.best_for: On-premise and self-hosted enterprise deployments requiring open weights with broad cloud aggregator fallback options

models.name: Grok-3
models.popularity_notes: Holds 2.4% of worldwide AI chatbot web-visit share in May 2026 and is listed among top five LLMs by multiple 2026 rankings; its deep integration with X (Twitter) gives it a unique real-time data advantage and a large built-in distribution channel.
strengths: Real-time web and X/Twitter data access for up-to-date responses
Strong performance on reasoning and STEM benchmarks
Integrated natively into X platform with large consumer reach
Witty conversational style differentiating from corporate-toned competitors
Rapidly growing API adoption
models.best_for: Real-time information retrieval, social media analytics, and applications requiring live web-grounded responses

models.name: Qwen3 / Qwen3-235B-A22B
models.popularity_notes: Adopted by over 90,000 enterprises globally per Shakudo research and ranked among top open-weight alternatives in multiple 2026 surveys; the 235B MoE variant leads open-weight coding and multilingual benchmarks, with strong HuggingFace download momentum.
strengths: Adopted by 90,000+ enterprises globally
Top multilingual performance across 29+ languages
Leading open-weight coding benchmark scores
Strong MoE efficiency at 235B parameter scale
Available on Alibaba Cloud with global enterprise support
models.best_for: Multilingual enterprise applications, coding automation, and Asia-Pacific deployments requiring strong localization support

models.name: Perplexity AI
models.popularity_notes: Holds 1.3% of worldwide chatbot web-visit share in May 2026 and is consistently cited in top AI chatbot rankings; its search-native architecture and Perplexity API have significant developer adoption among teams building retrieval-augmented generation applications.
strengths: Native real-time web search grounding on every query
Cited sources reduce hallucination risk for factual tasks
Sonar API optimized for RAG and search-augmented pipelines
Fast response times for research workflows
Growing enterprise API adoption
models.best_for: Research automation, real-time fact-checking, and RAG pipelines requiring grounded, cited responses

models.name: Microsoft Copilot (GPT-5-based)
models.popularity_notes: Holds 1.3% of worldwide chatbot web-visit share in May 2026 and benefits from deep integration across Microsoft 365, GitHub, and Azure OpenAI Service, giving it one of the largest enterprise distribution footprints of any AI assistant globally.
strengths: Embedded in Microsoft 365 suite used by 345M+ monthly active users
Deep GitHub Copilot integration for code generation
Azure OpenAI Service enterprise compliance and data residency
Bing Search grounding for real-time information
Native IT admin controls and enterprise security policies
models.best_for: Enterprises standardized on Microsoft 365 seeking AI-augmented productivity across Office, Teams, and developer tools

models.name: Mistral Large
models.popularity_notes: Consistently ranked among top open-weight models for speed and efficiency in 2026 surveys; available on AWS Bedrock, Azure AI, Google Vertex AI, and Snowflake Cortex, giving it strong aggregator coverage that amplifies its developer adoption well beyond direct Mistral API usage.
strengths: Best-in-class inference speed among frontier-tier models
Available on AWS Bedrock, Azure AI, Vertex AI, and Snowflake Cortex
Strong multilingual performance across European languages
Function-calling and JSON mode reliability
Competitive cost-to-performance ratio
models.best_for: Latency-sensitive enterprise APIs, multilingual European deployments, and high-throughput pipelines requiring fast structured outputs

models.name: GLM 5.2
models.popularity_notes: Released June 2026 with 743B parameters and a 1,040K-token context window, earning the strongest benchmark profile among open models per Fireworks AI analysis; its adoption is rising rapidly among enterprise teams requiring ultra-long context at open-weight cost.
strengths: Largest context window of any open-source model at 1,040K tokens
743B parameters delivering frontier-competitive benchmark scores
Strongest open-model benchmark profile as of June 2026
Full weight availability for self-hosted enterprise deployment
Strong Chinese and English bilingual performance
models.best_for: Ultra-long document analysis, legal and scientific research corpora, and enterprises requiring massive context in a self-hostable open model
